newsitem.title: UK: U.K. Intervention Board details EU sugar sales.
newsitem.headline: U.K. Intervention Board details EU sugar sales.

text.p: A total 88,250 tonnes of current series white sugar received export rebates of a maximum 46.704 European Currency Units (Ecus) per 100 kilos at Wednesday's European Union (EU) tender, the U.K. Intervention Board said.
Out of this, traders in France received 55,500 tonnes, in the U.K. 15,250, in Denmark 10,000 and in Belgium 7,500 tonnes, it added.
Earlier on Wednesday, London traders had expected the subsidy for the current season whites campaign for licences at 46.704 Ecus per 100 kilos, the exact amount awarded.
Traders had also forecast the total authorised sugar tonnage export awards to be between 60,000 and 90,000 tonnes versus 45,400 last week when the restitution was 47.002 Ecus.
